Hair Loss Symptoms Causes & Treatments

Hair loss can feel like a quiet thief, stealing your confidence strand by strand. You might notice a receding hairline, a thinner ponytail, or more hair in the shower drain than usual. Whether you’re just starting to notice the signs or deep into the frustration of trying every shampoo and serum under the sun, here’s the good news:

Hair loss is treatable.

But the key? Understanding what’s causing it—and choosing the right solution based on your unique situation. In this guide, we won’t just talk symptoms. We’ll give you the why, the what now, and introduce Facelit Clinic—your trusted partner in regrowing not just hair, but self-confidence.

What is Hair Loss, Really?

Hair loss isn’t just about going bald. It’s a symptom, not the disease. It can be slow and sneaky, or fast and dramatic. The good news? Once we know the type, we can target the treatment.

Types of Hair Loss You Should Know About

1. Androgenetic Alopecia (Male/Female Pattern Baldness) - Caused by genetics and hormones - Common in both men and women - Usually starts at temples or crown 2. Telogen Effluvium - Sudden shedding due to stress, illness, or hormonal changes - Often reversible 3. Alopecia Areata - Autoimmune disease where your body attacks hair follicles - Causes patchy bald spots 4. Traction Alopecia - Due to tight hairstyles or repeated pulling - Reversible if caught early 5. Scarring Alopecia - Permanent hair loss due to inflammation and follicle damage - Requires early medical intervention

Top Symptoms to Watch Out For

Don’t ignore the signs. Early detection = faster recovery.

  • Thinning on top of the head (most common)
  • Receding hairline
  • Bald spots or patches
  • Sudden handfuls of hair shedding
  • Itchy, inflamed scalp
  • Hair breaking mid-shaft

Why Am I Losing Hair? Top 8 Causes That Matter

Let’s cut through the noise. These are the real root causes we see every day at Facelit Clinic:

1. Genetics (Family History)
  • If baldness runs in your family, you’re more likely to experience it.
  • But genes aren’t destiny. We can still slow or reverse it.
2. Hormonal Imbalances
  • Thyroid issues, PCOS, menopause, or pregnancy can trigger hair changes.
  • Lab tests can pinpoint what’s off—and guide treatment.
3. Nutritional Deficiencies
  • Low iron, zinc, protein, or vitamin D? Hair will suffer.
  • We test and fix these at Facelit before jumping to products.
4. Stress & Trauma
  • Emotional or physical stress pushes hair follicles into “resting mode.”
  • The result? Sudden shedding a few months later.
5. Medical Conditions
  • Autoimmune diseases, scalp infections, or chronic illness
  • Underlying issues must be addressed for any hair regrowth to stick.
6. Medications
  • Common culprits: antidepressants, birth control, blood thinners, and chemo.
  • In many cases, hair returns post-treatment.
7. Poor Hair Care Practices
  • Frequent bleaching, heat styling, tight braids, or chemical relaxers
  • These weaken and kill follicles over time.
8. Aging
  • As we age, hair naturally thins due to slower regeneration.
  • But that doesn’t mean you can’t intervene!

Hair loss is a signal. So, when should you act?

Here’s the rule: If you’re worried, it’s worth checking out.

Don't wait until it’s too late. Early intervention prevents permanent damage.

Seek professional help if:

  • You notice bald patches or rapid thinning
  • You’re shedding more than 100 hairs a day
  • Your scalp is itchy, flaky, or sore
  • Your hair doesn’t grow back after shedding

How Hair Loss is Diagnosed (What to Expect at Facelit Clinic)

At Facelit Clinic, we don’t guess—we test. Here’s how we zero in on the problem:

  1. Detailed Consultation & History
  2. Scalp & Follicle Analysis (Trichoscopy)
  3. Blood Tests for iron, thyroid, vitamin levels, hormones
  4. Pull Test to measure active shedding
  5. Scalp Biopsy if needed to check for scarring conditions

Effective Treatments for Hair Loss—What Works

Forget the hype, the hair oils, and the gimmicks trending on social media. When you’re facing real hair loss, you need real solutions—backed by science, tailored to your scalp, and delivered by experts.

At Facelit Clinic, we don’t do “one-size-fits-all.” We offer cutting-edge, medically proven treatments designed to address hair loss at its root (literally). Whether you're just starting to thin or dealing with advanced balding, here’s what actually works—and what we do best.

1. PRP Therapy (Platelet-Rich Plasma)

Think of it as healing from within. PRP uses a small sample of your own blood, spins it down to concentrate the powerful platelets, and re-injects it into your scalp.

  • Stimulates dormant follicles
  • Boosts natural hair growth
  • Improves hair thickness and strength
  • No downtime, no chemicals, no risk of rejection

Perfect for early-stage hair loss or postpartum shedding. At Facelit Clinic, we enhance PRP with advanced protocols for maximum regrowth.

2. GFC Treatment (Growth Factor Concentrate)

GFC is PRP's more powerful cousin. While PRP uses whole platelets, GFC isolates the purest growth factors from your blood and delivers them directly to your scalp.

  • Faster results than traditional PRP
  • Reduces hair fall
  • Improves follicle regeneration
  • Minimally invasive & completely natural

Ideal for both men and women who want stronger, thicker, and faster-growing hair without surgery.

3. QR678 Therapy

QR678 is a game-changing injectable formula developed by Indian scientists—now approved worldwide.

  • Contains six essential biomimetic peptides that naturally stimulate hair growth
  • FDA-approved, non-surgical, and backed by clinical trials
  • Quick, painless sessions
  • Results visible in just a few sittings

Facelit Clinic offers QR678 as part of our premium regrowth package, especially for those who’ve tried everything else.

4. Hair Botox Therapy

Nope, it’s not the same Botox you get for wrinkles. Hair Botox is a deep-repair conditioning treatment that restores damaged, brittle, or chemically treated hair.

  • Smooths frizz, seals split ends
  • Strengthens weak strands
  • Adds volume and bounce
  • Improves scalp health for better hair retention

It’s a perfect companion to hair loss treatments like PRP or GFC. Think of it as rehab for your tired hair.

5. Exosome Hair Regeneration Therapy

One of the most advanced treatments in regenerative medicine, Exosome therapy is a cell-derived formula that activates your scalp’s healing ability on a cellular level.

  • Contains stem cell-derived exosomes rich in growth factors
  • Signals hair follicles to grow, repair, and regenerate
  • Works even in advanced cases where PRP alone may not be enough
  • Completely non-surgical and chemical-free

At Facelit Clinic, we combine exosome therapy with microneedling or laser to maximize absorption and results.

6. PDO Thread Therapy for Hair Regrowth

Yes, threads aren't just for face lifting anymore. PDO (Polydioxanone) threads can be inserted into the scalp to stimulate collagen production and boost blood flow to hair follicles.

  • Rejuvenates the scalp from within
  • Long-lasting stimulation for sustained hair growth
  • Boosts the effectiveness of PRP or Exosome therapy
  • Suitable for receding hairlines and patchy areas

This is ideal for clients looking for next-level regenerative support, especially in stubborn bald spots.

Game-Changing Lifestyle Changes to Support Regrowth

These small tweaks can make a massive difference:

  • Eat more protein (hair = keratin = protein!)
  • Get 7-8 hours of sleep
  • Avoid smoking and alcohol (they constrict blood flow to the scalp)
  • Massage your scalp daily
  • Switch to sulfate-free shampoos

Natural Remedies—Helpful or Hype?

Some work as support—not cures:

  • Rosemary oil (stimulates follicles)
  • Castor oil (great for hair shaft health)
  • Saw Palmetto (natural DHT blocker)

But don’t expect miracles. Combine these with clinical treatment for best results.

Conclusion: Regain Your Hair—and Your Confidence

Hair loss doesn’t define you—but treating it can redefine how you feel. Whether it’s genetics, stress, or hormones messing with your mane, don’t settle for cover-ups or guesswork. With the right diagnosis, a custom plan, and expert help from Facelit Clinic, you can stop hair loss in its tracks—and grow stronger, healthier hair.

FAQ

  • 1. What’s the first thing I should do if I notice hair loss?

    Don’t panic, but don’t ignore it either. The earlier you act, the easier it is to treat. Book a consultation with a clinic like Facelit Clinic so they can run proper tests and identify what’s really going on beneath the scalp.

  • 2. How do I know if it’s temporary shedding or permanent hair loss?

    Temporary hair loss (like Telogen Effluvium) often happens after stress or illness and may grow back in a few months. If you notice a receding hairline, patchy bald spots, or progressive thinning, it could be permanent. At Facelit Clinic, we perform a detailed scalp analysis to distinguish between the two.

  • 3. Can women get hair loss treatments too?

    Absolutely! Hair loss in women is very common, especially due to hormonal shifts like menopause, PCOS, or pregnancy. Facelit Clinic offers female-friendly options including PRP therapy, laser treatments, and hormonal assessments designed specifically for women.

  • 4. Will PRP therapy really help me regrow hair?

    PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) uses your body’s natural healing cells to stimulate dormant hair follicles. It’s backed by science and ideal for early-to-mid-stage hair loss. Most patients at Facelit Clinic see visible results in 3–6 months with zero downtime.

  • 5. I’ve tried shampoos, oils, and vitamins. Why isn’t anything working?

    Because those are just surface-level fixes. If the root cause is internal—like hormones or genetics—no topical product will fix it alone. That’s why Facelit Clinic runs blood tests, hormonal panels, and scalp scans to uncover the real issue and tailor your treatment plan.

  • 6. Are hair transplants permanent—and do they look natural?

    Yes and yes. When done right (like with FUE at Facelit Clinic), transplanted hair is permanent and looks completely natural because it’s your own hair, just relocated. We design your hairline to suit your face shape for a natural, age-appropriate look.

  • 7. How long does it take to see results from hair loss treatments?

    The best treatment depends on the cause and stage of your hair loss. At Facelit Clinic, we offer personalized consultations to assess your scalp condition, hair density, and medical history. Based on this evaluation, our experts will recommend the most suitable option—whether it’s PRP, GFC, QR 678, Exosomes, Hair Botox, or Scalp Micropigmentation—to ensure safe and effective results tailored to your needs.

  • 8. Can stress really make my hair fall out?

    Yes—stress can shock hair follicles into a dormant phase, causing sudden shedding (telogen effluvium). The good news? It’s usually reversible. With stress reduction and treatments like scalp therapy or PRP, your hair can bounce back. Facelit Clinic treats both the symptoms and the source.

  • 9. Is there a treatment plan if I don’t want surgery?

    Definitely. Non-surgical options like PRP, laser therapy, topical solutions, and nutritional support can deliver great results—especially if your hair loss is caught early. Facelit Clinic specializes in non-invasive treatments tailored to your comfort and goals.

  • 10. What’s different about getting treated at Facelit Clinic?

    At Facelit Clinic, we don’t just sell you a product—we create a custom strategy. You get:

    - One-on-one consults with real experts - In-depth scalp scans and lab tests - Natural and medical treatment options - Transparent pricing and supportive care It’s not just about your hair—it’s about your confidence, your identity, your story.
